narrative.overview:
A matte black-graphite cockpit panel with fine grain and four corner screws. The page reads as instruments cross-checking one another: each headline result is a round gauge with a radium-green needle on a near-black face, a terse placard cap underneath, and an evidence line that names its source. Below the hero the page continues as a flight log, an avionics stack, approach plates and a comms panel, all in the same panel material.

The system is calm and dense rather than loud. Type is condensed and uppercase where it labels or announces (placards), and plain humanist sans where it explains. Green is the live-data voice, amber is the one lit action, everything else is graphite and off-white. A DAY/NIGHT dimmer flips the panel to a pale daylight face with black markings; the instrument faces themselves stay dark in both modes.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite panel, grain overlay on the whole page, hairline borders, 2-4px corners.
Placard lettering: Barlow Condensed, uppercase, 0.14em tracking.
Radium green for needles, live values and company/role accents; amber for lit actions.
Instrument faces (face, tick, needle) are mode-independent and always dark.
Motion is mechanical: an underdamped needle sweep and short ease-out reveals; reduced motion snaps to final state.

rules.name: The One Lit Action Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the thing the visitor should press or the single lamp that is on. It never fills decorative surfaces or large areas.

rules.name: The Dark Dial Rule
rules.body: Gauge face, ticks and needle do not follow the DAY/NIGHT switch. The panel around them changes; the instruments do not.

rules.name: The Green Is Data Rule
rules.body: Green means a measured value or the identity line, never a button fill.

rules.name: The Placard Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, names or acts is Barlow Condensed uppercase at 0.14em. Anything that explains is Barlow sentence case.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every figure, date range and tool tag is B612 Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Lens, Not Halo Rule
rules.body: Lamps and status dots are solid radial-gradient lenses. No outer glow.

rules.name: The Flat Between Panels Rule
rules.body: Only panels and the primary action carry a shadow; sections, rows and chips are flat.

dos: Do letter every label, button, nav item and gauge caption in Barlow Condensed uppercase with 0.14em tracking.
Do set every number, date and tool tag in B612 Mono with tabular figures.
Do build new surfaces from `.panel`, hairline borders and 2-4px corners; use `.panel-screws` on larger plates.
Do show a source alongside any new headline figure, following the gauge evidence line.
Do keep instrument faces, ticks and needles dark in both panel modes.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: needles snap to value and transitions drop to 0.01ms.
donts: Don't use amber for decoration or large fills; it is the lit action and the single lamp.
Don't use red; the destructive token exists but no surface uses it.
Don't add glow, halo or neon treatments to green, lamps or text.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings, section numbers or gradient text.
Don't invent a third accent hue or round the panel corners past 4px.
Don't bring a headline-over-three-cards layout back into a section.
